notes: Fire layer skipped: no burnt-area data; fire weight rescaled away.
Species whose GBIF match is a synonym or shares a key are flagged in dataQuality; see flagLegend.
IUCN 'Not assessed' (NE) means no assessment exists; it is not a low-risk category.

flagLegend.gbif_synonym_match: GBIF treats the matched name as a synonym; records follow GBIF's accepted species.
flagLegend.gbif_shared_key: Shares its GBIF species key with another Chloris species; records go to the GBIF-accepted one.
flagLegend.gbif_no_match: No usable GBIF match; no occurrence data.
flagLegend.name_only_match: Medicinal flag matched to WCVP by name, not IPNI id; awaiting science-lead review.
flagLegend.native_status_check: Native status or inclusion needs a science-lead decision (see reason).
